title: Python Core & Advanced Engineering Standards
skills: Python, GIL, Generators, Asyncio, Memory Management, Typing
description:
Python Engineering Competency Overview:
Requirements & Core Concepts:
- Deep understanding of Python internals: Global Interpreter Lock (GIL), garbage collection (reference counting + cyclic GC), and memory management.
- Asynchronous programming using asyncio, event loops, coroutines, and task management.
- Metaprogramming with decorators, dunder methods, generators, context managers, and descriptors.
- Clean architecture: Type hinting (PEP 484), dataclasses, Pydantic validation, and modular packaging.
Interview Expectations:
- Candidates must explain time complexity of dictionary lookups (hash collisions and open addressing).
- Ability to profile code with cProfile, memory_profiler, and optimize bottlenecks with vectorization or multiprocessing.

title: Production LLM & RAG Systems Architecture
skills: RAG, Vector DB, Chroma, FAISS, Embeddings, Cross-Encoders, Ragas, LangChain
description:
Production RAG & Generative AI Standards:
Core Architecture:
- Dense vector retrieval using bi-encoders (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, BGE) combined with sparse keyword retrieval (BM25) via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
- Cross-Encoder re-ranking to calibrate semantic relevance and filter out noisy context before passing to LLM context windows.
- Hierarchical section-aware chunking with parent-document metadata propagation to eliminate context fragmentation.
Evaluation & Guardrails:
- Quantitative evaluation using the RAG Triad: Context Precision, Context Recall, and Faithfulness (groundedness).
- Hallucination mitigation through strict negative system prompts, source citation constraints, and similarity score cutoffs.

title: Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Kubernetes Standards
skills: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, Helm, Observability
description:
Cloud & Container Orchestration Standards:
Core Architecture & Requirements:
- Docker containerization: Multi-stage builds, minimal base images (Alpine/Distroless), non-root users, and layer caching.
- Kubernetes orchestration: Pod lifecycle, Deployments, ReplicaSets, Services (ClusterIP/NodePort/Ingress), ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA).
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for AWS resources (VPC, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM roles).
- CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions / GitLab CI, including automated linting, unit testing, image vulnerability scanning (Trivy), and deployment pipelines.

title: Data Engineering, Streaming & Warehouse Standards
skills: SQL, Apache Spark, PySpark, Airflow, Snowflake, Kafka, Data Modeling
description:
Data Engineering Competency Standards:
Core Architecture & Requirements:
- Distributed data processing with Apache Spark (PySpark): RDDs vs DataFrames, catalyst optimizer, partition tuning, shuffle minimization, and broadcast joins.
- Data modeling: Star schema, snowflake schema, slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1 & 2), and columnar storage (Parquet/ORC).
- Workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow: DAG architecture, operators, sensors, backfilling, and XCom best practices.
- Advanced SQL: Window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK), CTEs, indexing strategies (B-Tree, Hash), and query execution plan analysis (EXPLAIN ANALYZE).
